# CANDIDA ALBICANS

Oropharyngeal candidal disease may present in different patterns, like white plaques in the oropharyngeal area, erythematous macules (often in patients with dentures), or as pseudomembranes. Thrush infection often recurs, especially in patients with AIDS.

Avoid using fluconazole empirically to treat candidal infections in patients who have received an imidazole in the previous year.

Consult MRTC clinic or Infectious Diseases (MRTC may also be consulted in the MVAHCS) for more information on treatment of recurrent infection.

References:
Mandell chapter: Candida Species
Pappas et al. Clinical Infectious Diseases. 2016, 62(4)e1-50
Sanford keyword: Candidiasis, Candidemia or Disseminated
Up-to-Date article: Treatment of candidemia and invasive candidiasis in adults
Therapy:
## Inpatient

## Treatment of thrush or oropharyngeal candidiasis

Mild disease:
Nystatin swish and swallow q6h for 7-14 days [M]
< OR >
Clotrimazole troche 10 mg PO 5X/day for 7-14 days [M]

Moderate to severe disease:
Fluconazole 200 mg PO q24h for 7-14 days [R,DI]

## Esophageal candidiasis

Esophageal infection requires systemic therapy.

Preferred:
Fluconazole 400 mg PO q24h for 14-21 days [R,DI]

Alternative for patient who cannot swallow tablets:
Fluconazole 400 IV q24h for 14-21 days [R,DI]
<OR>
Micafungin 100-150mg IV q24h for 14-21 days

## Systemic candidal infection

Fluconazole is preferred empirical therapy in most cases. Amphotericin B should be used empirically in patients who have received an azole antifungal drug recently, or in patients who are critically ill.

Duration of Therapy: Duration of therapy is dependent upon location, severity of infection, and response to therapy. Consult Infectious Diseases for more information.

Preferred:
Fluconazole 800 mg PO once then 400 mg PO q24h [R,DI]
< OR >
Fluconazole 800 mg IV once then 400 mg IV q24h [R,DI]

Recent azole antifungal treatment:
Liposomal amphotericin (Ambisome) 3-5 mg/kg IV q24h [R,O]
< OR >
Micafungin 100-150 mg IV q24h [H,DI]

## Outpatient

Nystatin swish and swallow QID for 7-14 days ($) [M]
